thread:
tanya: Postmortem follow-up: We saw repeated 99p spikes on /v1/stream and some throughput degradation during the weekend batch job. Need owners for three tracks: micro-SLO (cohorted), batching/queue guardrails, and dashboards/alerts + runbooks.

leo: I'll own batching/queue guardrails. Plan: introduce a separate high-cost queue for sequences >1000 tokens, cap its batch window to 5ms, and add a backpressure qps cap. Will include debug metrics for queue-length and head-of-line time. ETA: Wed EOD.

harper: I'll take dashboards/alerting. Split the 95/99 alerts, add an "error-budget burn rate" panel (30m window) and a throughput-vs-99p scatter. Also going to add a descriptive runbook link in alert bodies. ETA: Thu morning.

monitor-bot: Canary deployed: opt-batcher v5 -> canary 8% at 2026-05-03T02:12:00Z (sha: bc1234).

tanya: For the micro-SLO tweak: propose a 5-day cohort tweak for requests with header X-Model: high-mem only. Rationale: localized impact, preserves global SLO integrity. Nina, can you draft the RFC with rollback gates?

nina: Yep. Draft will include rollback gate: 99p < 1.0s for 2 consecutive 3h windows and error-budget burn rate < 1.5x for 6h. Also will include communication checklist for PM/CS and a short template for status updates. ETA: Friday a.m.

leo: Note on canary: after merging patch, I'll run 24h at 8% then 24h at 30% if stable. Metrics to watch: 99p latency by model, queue wait, CPU and GPU utilization, and tail p99.9.

harper: Proposed alert rule (staging) for error budget burn:
```
alert: SLOErrorBudgetBurnHigh
expr: increase(sum(rate(error_budget_spent_total[30m])) by (team), 0) > 2
for: 15m
labels:
  severity: page
```
I'll attach the runbook and include a brief step list: scale pool, route to fallback-variant, enable prefix cache.

tanya: Please make the alert clear about the cohort selector so we don't overreact to unrelated services. Also include short mitigation steps in the alert text.

leo: PR created: https://git.internal/r/platform/opt-batcher/pulls/101 (queue caps + qps limiter + metrics).

nina: RFC draft: https://docs.internal/slo/micro-slo-highmem-2026.md 1 includes cohort selector, rollback gates, and a CS/PM notification template.

harper: Dashboard (staging) posted: https://grafana.internal/d/xyz123/throughput-latency-burn. Will add link in the RFC.

tanya: Ownership recap: batching/guardrails = leo; dashboard/alerts/runbook = harper; micro-SLO RFC & comms = nina. I'll own the incident board updates and follow-ups. Please add tasks and milestone dates.

leo: Added incident I-7203 with milestones and canary schedule. Canary windows: 24h@8% then 24h@30% then ramp.

harper: After testing alerts in staging I'll post the alert rule links and the runbook snippet here. ETA Thu.

nina: Will send the comms template to PM/CS after RFC finalizes.

tanya: Weekly ops sync next Tue 09:30 to review error-budget trajectory and canary telemetry; if any pages before then mark with tag "latency-throughput-guardrail" for aggregation.

leo: Monitoring the canary now, will report abnormalities.

monitor-bot: Canary health: 99p stable in initial window. Next ramp scheduled.

tanya: Thanks team. Keep updates concise here and add blockers ASAP. :thumbsup:
